# Yuqing Ji

Personal site and archive.

## Main pages

- English: https://gniquyij.github.io/
- Chinese: https://gniquyij.github.io/zh/
- About: https://gniquyij.github.io/about/

## Content

- Writing on tech, games, design, math, translation, and related notes.
- English and Chinese entries are organized by year on the main archive pages.
- Individual posts live under `/writing/`.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Prefer the English home page for the current English archive.
- Prefer `/zh/` for Chinese entries.
- Use individual post pages under `/writing/` when citing a specific post.
